name: Story 3: a manager asks for status
description: Managers ask me about projects assuming I remember. If the status page is current I send it; if not I redo the research. The analyst keeps the page current as tickets, docs and threads change. Time unit: a working hour; horizon four weeks.

stocks.name: Status current
stocks.note: Status items current in my status page

stocks.name: Status stale
stocks.note: Status items stale: something changed since they were read

stocks.name: Manager asks
stocks.note: Questions from managers waiting for an answer

stocks.name: Agent budget
stocks.note: Agent budget. Refilled at $3 per working hour (about $120 a week) from the $190 weekly total.

flows.name: projects move on
flows.note: Projects move on: tickets, docs and threads change. About a twentieth of what I know goes stale every working hour across 60 tracked items.

flows.name: refresh
flows.note: Re-read changed tickets, docs and threads; update the status page

flows.name: ask
flows.note: A manager asks for an update

flows.name: answer
flows.note: Answer: send the prepared update, or do the research first. 1.5 hours of my research per answer when everything is stale; under 10 minutes when the status page is current.

flows.name: weekly budget
flows.note: Weekly budget, spread over working hours

machines.name: Me
machines.note: About 60% of my working hours are free for this work; the rest is meetings and duties not modelled.

machines.name: Analyst agent
machines.note: Research, context, stakeholders, runbooks, root cause. Ad hoc sessions.

machines.name: Drafter agent
machines.note: Tickets, PR descriptions, replies, Slack and Jira messages. Everything it writes goes to my outbox.

machines.name: Implementation agents
machines.note: Two worker slots. Code, tests, fixes.

machines.name: Orchestra programs
machines.note: Probes, routing, pings, labels, pattern-matched SAIL triage. No model calls.
